initial.prompt: Use case ui-mockup. High-fidelity Obsidian desktop dark theme, crisp Inter/system sans, charcoal #1e1e1e / #252525, off-white readable text, subtle hairlines, rounded checkboxes, small outline icons, muted blue, green, gray and purple planner blocks. Match the attached reference's restrained native Obsidian design. New synthetic tasks only. No ID strings, code metadata, technical engine text, decorative dashboards or device frames. Create a landscape design board with TWO clearly separated app screenshot panels, each with a narrow caption above the screenshot. Both panels must have legible concise UI and align all fields and time slots. Each panel is approximately 1100 pixels wide at high fidelity. Panel A caption 'Connect Todoist'. Obsidian Tasks docked pane showing onboarding with heading Tasks, Todoist source selected, central 'Connect Todoist' action, expandable 'Use an API token' section with password field and Save and connect, brief permission text 'Read and update tasks'. Small Connected account summary after success in an inset. Panel B caption 'Projects and capture rules'. Day Planner settings page with Tasks section. Connection row Todoist Connected, Disconnect action. Project mapping rows '#work → Work', '#karma → Karma', '#apara → Apara', '#yukti → Yukti' using small dropdowns. 'New task default' set to Inbox. A setting 'Create tasks marked #todoist' enabled. 'Scheduling updates Todoist date and time' enabled. Small helper 'Recurring tasks keep their repeat rule'. No deadline field.

revisions.prompt: Refine the attached dark Obsidian design board. Preserve the visual system and right-hand project routing settings. Replace the left onboarding with one coherent initial release token connection screen. Heading Connect Todoist, short text 'Connect your tasks to Day Planner', a labelled password input 'API token', a small link 'Find your API token', primary button 'Connect', and Cancel. Remove the separate OAuth connect button, the 'or' separator and the connected success card from this disconnected screen. Right-hand connected settings should say 'Connected account' with a synthetic account name and Disconnect. Include a compact expandable 'Connection help' row. Keep #work, #karma, #apara, #yukti project mappings readable. No deadlines. Make it plausible to implement without a hosted auth server.

Refine this dark Obsidian task browsing board. Keep all visual styling and left search/filter screen. In the right Tasks pane remove the duplicate Shopping group header. Show Today as the date group with one Shopping parent task row, its three indented descendants Buy fruit, Buy rice and Check pantry nested under Buy rice. Its parent row is selected and expanded with child-count 3. The right task details remain Shopping with readable fields and no deadline. Use a calendar-minus outline icon for Remove from schedule, never a trash icon. Keep a single instance of each task row and accurate counts.

Refine this dark Obsidian Markdown capture board preserving the style and all clean Markdown. The Admin line has only #work and is a local schedule block. Remove Admin from the Tasks pane because only #todoist opts a new Markdown task into task sync. Keep Review build and Buy plant ties in the task list. Give the unscheduled Buy plant ties a No date chip and put it in a No date group, not Today. On the lower editing screenshot replace every trash icon on Remove from schedule with a calendar-minus icon. Keep clean readable #todoist #karma tags and the 'Syncs when you finish this line' popover.

Refine this dark Obsidian recurring task board. In the left screenshot keep Water plants completed in today's planner and the task detail showing Next occurrence Tomorrow, 08:00. In the Tasks pane Tomorrow group explicitly show one unchecked 'Water plants' row with Home and Tomorrow 08:00. Remove Buy groceries from that Tomorrow group. Today's completed Water plants can remain in a small Completed today group, while Today active shows Write summary and Plan weekend. Ensure counts match displayed rows. Keep right one-task-one-calendar-block screen but use independent checkbox toggles for calendar visibility, not radio buttons. Day Planner calendar checked and Todoist calendar feed unchecked. No other changes.

Refine the attached four-state dark Obsidian board. Keep offline and empty states. Simplify the top-right conflict modal to one clear per-field choice. Show Title choices Review draft (In note) / Review final draft (In Todoist), and Time choices 10:00 (In note) / 11:00 (In Todoist). No choice preselected for conflicting fields. Bottom buttons only Cancel and 'Apply choices', with Apply choices disabled until both fields are chosen. Remove whole-task radio choices and redundant Use note version / Use Todoist version buttons. In narrow pane bottom right replace context menu Delete with Open in Todoist, keep Schedule... and Rename... only. Preserve restrained high-fidelity style.
